doors.label: VARGA
doors.name: Varga's office
doors.text: A steel door with a brass nameplate, VARGA, polished. Locked when she is out, which is not often.

doors.name: Quarters D-1
doors.text: D-1. ALBU on a card in a brass holder.

doors.name: Quarters D-2
doors.text: D-2. RUS, typed, the card perfectly straight.

doors.name: Quarters D-3
doors.text: D-3. KISS, in pencil. The door is propped open with a medical textbook.

props.name: Logbook bench
props.text: The valve log: every turn of every wheel, signed and dated. Since the second generation, most entries are signed RUS.

props.name: Key locker
props.text: Steel, chained. The radiator keys hang inside in rows, each on its own numbered hook. Four hooks are empty.

props.name: Workbench
props.text: A half-rebuilt pump impeller, its blades built up with weld and filed back by hand.

props.name: Lathe
props.text: The silo's only lathe. Its maker's plate is from 1951; its belts are cut from a conveyor in a closed section.

props.name: Parts shelf
props.text: Gaskets cut from inner tubes, labelled by size. Bearings in jars of oil.

props.name: Crate
props.text: SPARES - EXCHANGER. Nearly empty.

props.name: Lockers
props.text: Mira's overalls, a spare set of yours, a photo of the first crew taped inside a door.

props.name: Council table
props.text: Long enough for twelve. Four chairs are used; the rest are pushed back against the wall.

props.name: Chair at the head
props.text: The chair at the head of the table, with a cushion. Varga's.

props.name: Lamp
props.text: A brass standard lamp. The Level 1 inventory lists one like it as missing.

props.name: Council records
props.text: Minutes, valve orders, ration tables. The spines are dated in Albu's handwriting.

props.name: Varga's terminal
props.text: A green-screen terminal, the only one still working. The menu lists DIRECTIVES, RATIONS, POPULATION. It asks for a password.

props.name: Safe
props.text: An old Romanian-made safe, painted green. The dial is worn smooth around three numbers.

props.name: Filing cabinet
props.text: Personnel files. Each resident's trade, health record and number.

props.name: Camp bed
props.text: A narrow cot made up with military corners. Varga sleeps here, next to the terminal.

props.name: Radio set
props.text: Dusted daily, powered never. The log beside it has one entry per year: NOTHING HEARD.

props.name: Map table
props.text: A survey map of the valley above. The town is circled in red. Someone has pencilled a date beside it.

props.name: Albu's bed
props.text: A real bed with a real mattress, on the priority circuit. Nobody on Level 2 sleeps like this.

props.name: Locker
props.text: Locked.

props.name: Rus's bed
props.text: A real bed with a real mattress, on the priority circuit. Nobody on Level 2 sleeps like this.

props.name: Locker
props.text: Locked.

props.name: Dr. Kiss's bed
props.text: A real bed with a real mattress, on the priority circuit. Nobody on Level 2 sleeps like this.

props.name: Locker
props.text: Locked.

props.name: Albu's desk
props.text: A ledger open at this week's rations, and a jar of sugar lumps with a paper lid.

props.name: Dr. Kiss's desk
props.text: Medical journals from 1951, read to pieces. A drawing of Oana's, of the clinic, pinned above it.

inspect.name: Valve manifold
inspect.text: Four wheels, chained and padlocked. Tags in three handwritings: PRIORITY - COMMAND, PRIORITY - CLINIC, GENERAL - L2 EAST, GENERAL - L1. The newest tag says COUNCIL ORDER: HALF TURN ONLY.

inspect.name: Valve manifold
inspect.text: Water treatment, the bays, Level 3. One wheel at the end has no tag at all and no chain. Its pipe runs up into the ceiling and east, towards the exchanger hall. The wheel is open, and by the dust it always has been.

inspect.name: Tool board
inspect.text: Painted outlines of thirty tools. Seven are still there. The rest were traded, broken or taken to closed sections and never brought back.

inspect.name: Banner
inspect.text: COUNCIL OF SILO 81, in gold thread on red wool that was a curtain once.

inspect.name: General plan
inspect.text: The founders' plan of the silo, four levels and the core. Behind the exchanger hall it shows solid rock.

inspect.name: Exchanger hall
inspect.text: Heavy steel, warm to the touch, the wheel greased. Beyond it, the bore, the exchanger and Mira's crew. (The exchanger hall is the next map to be built.)
